title: Skip Delay Settings Schema
description: JSON Schema for skip delay feature settings stored in electron-store

skipDelayEnabled.description: Controls whether skip delay feature is active. When false, skip button is immediately available (current behavior). When true, skip button is disabled for skipDelayDuration milliseconds.

skipDelayDuration.description: Number of milliseconds skip button remains disabled when skipDelayEnabled is true. Value is stored in milliseconds but displayed in seconds in UI (1-300 seconds = 1000-300000 milliseconds).
